title: Autism Diagnosis Rate Reached 1 In 31
closing: Better detection helps children get support, but it does not prove autism itself increased.
question: Has screening changed near you?

segments.say: Autism prevalence reached 32.2 per thousand children, making diagnoses far more common than two decades earlier.
Autism diagnoses are 3.4 times more common in boys, showing girls may still be missed.
Autism rates vary more than fivefold by site, proving where and how clinicians look changes the count.
